scope: Freeze the last complete visible vector drawing during background repair, then replace it when current geometry is accepted.

screenGap.definition: first sampled closing-brace text/border at its new column to first sampled vertical guide at the corresponding new column
screenGap.environment: IC 2024.2.6; Linux amd64 emulation on arm64; Xvfb96 1920x1080; JetBrains Mono14; isolated screen crop 400x240
screenGap.capture: 120 Hz requested; original variable frame timestamps retained (encoder/muxer time base 1 microsecond); statistics use original frame PTS, not CFR frame counts

validation.negativeControls: Bypassing frozen rendering and comparing integer graphics origins each caused their regression test to fail.

limitations: One sequential session per revision with 24 settled Tab/Shift+Tab actions; descriptive results, not evidence of a latency improvement.
The screen gap begins at sampled text movement, not physical key input. Capture requests 120 Hz and retains variable original timestamps.
Linux amd64 emulation results do not guarantee native macOS or continuous rapid-typing latency.
The full drawing stays at its old position while repair is pending. Layout changes discard it; an absent prior drawing cannot be replayed.
Original videos, frame data, diagnostic logs and installation archives remain local. This file publishes aggregate results and source hashes only.

postCaptureCompatibilityFix.change: Removed the experimental custom-fold-property callback; stable fold-state/removal and inlay listeners remain. Rendering and measured Tab/Shift+Tab paths are unchanged.
postCaptureCompatibilityFix.validation: Repeated :check, minimumSdkTests, currentSdkTests, buildPlugin and verifyPluginStructure successfully.
